purpose: Test whether Notebook 60's unchanged within-sector selected-long gross advantage is explained by conventional strictly lagged price and liquidity characteristics.

provenance.precedent: Notebook 60 found selected-long minus same-sector equal-weight gross contribution of +3.662 bps per session with a positive block-bootstrap interval.
provenance.classification: post-result explanatory confound audit, not independent confirmation or a new strategy

candidate.source: Notebook 36 equal-weight Gemma-event-timing and FinBERT-ranking hybrid
candidate.universe: immutable original LSEG sector-33, three companies in each of 11 sectors
candidate.weights: positive Notebook 36 target weights only; every date, name, count, and weight unchanged
candidate.outcome: same one-session split-adjusted open-to-open return used by Notebooks 36 and 60
candidate.reference_identity: the selected-weighted sector-date-demeaned outcome must exactly reproduce Notebook 60 selected-long minus same-sector equal-weight daily contribution within 1e-12

characteristics.sigma20: rolling sample standard deviation of open-to-open returns over at most 20 sessions with at least 5 observations, shifted one complete session
characteristics.log_adv20: natural log of rolling mean close times volume over at most 20 sessions with at least 5 observations, shifted one complete session
characteristics.point_in_time_boundary: no current-session price, volume, sentiment, or forward return enters any characteristic
characteristics.standardization: mean and sample standard deviation fitted on complete nonselected firm-session rows only; zero variance fails closed

attribution.fixed_effect: demean outcome and standardized characteristics within each session-sector cell
attribution.coefficient_sample: complete firm-session rows with zero selected-long weight only
attribution.coefficient_model: pooled no-intercept OLS of sector-date-demeaned next-open return on the four sector-date-demeaned characteristics
attribution.explained_path: selected weights times fitted characteristic component

inference.primary_estimand: mean characteristic-adjusted selected-long residual gross contribution across all 167 complete sessions
inference.method: two-sided circular moving-block bootstrap over sessions with the characteristic coefficients refitted inside every replicate
inference.multiplicity_family: one new primary residual test; the Notebook 60 raw reference and feature contributions are descriptive

interpretation.robust_residual: mean positive, 95% interval lower bound above zero, and both descriptive chronological-half means positive
interpretation.positive_uncertain: mean positive but interval crosses zero or one half is nonpositive
